He previously played for the [[Alabama Crimson Tide men's basketball|Alabama Crimson Tide]]. ==Early life== Bradley originally grew up in [[Rochester, New York]].{{cite web|url=https://www.democratandchronicle.com/story/sports/high-school/2022/04/14/how-rochesters-jaden-bradley-became-five-star-recruit/7166823001/|title=How Rochester's Jaden Bradley became a five-star recruit|work=[[Democrat and Chronicle]]|date=April 14, 2022|access-date=January 12, 2023}} His family moved to [[Charlotte, North Carolina]] while he was in elementary school and attended the [[Cannon School]] in [[Concord, North Carolina]].{{cite web|url=https://www.democratandchronicle.com/story/sports/high-school/2020/04/10/jaden-bradley-cannon-high-school-north-carolina-class-of-2022-top-recruit-rochester-ny-native/2974270001/|title=Jaden Bradley: Rochester native stars in basketball in North Carolina|first=Billy|last=Heyen|work=[[Democrat and Chronicle]]|date=April 10, 2020|access-date=January 11, 2023}} Bradley was named the 2020 North Carolina Gatorade Player of the Year after averaging 23.1 points, 6.4 rebounds, 6.1 assists, and 2.9 steals per game.{{cite web|url=https://independenttribune.com/townnews/sport/bradley-wins-gatorade-player-of-year/article_c39bf962-9798-540c-acd9-d9a736ccd87b.html|title=Bradley wins Gatorade player of year|work=[[Independent Tribune]]|date=July 12, 2020|access-date=January 11, 2023}} He transferred to [[IMG Academy]] in [[Bradenton, Florida]] before the start of his junior year.{{cite web|url=https://www.charlotteobserver.com/sports/high-school/article243494336.html|title=Star point guard Jaden Bradley transferring to IMG Academy|work=[[The Charlotte Observer]]|date=June 12, 2020|access-date=January 11, 2023}} Bradley averaged 11.4 points and led the team with 4.6 assists and two steals per game in his only season at IMG.{{cite web|url=https://www.si.com/college/alabama/bamacentral/freshman-jaden-bradley-brings-traditional-point-guard-play-back-to-alabama-basketball|title=Freshman Jaden Bradley Brings Traditional Point Guard Play Back to Alabama Basketball|first=Blake|last=Byler|website=[[SI.com]]|date=July 25, 2022|access-date=January 11, 2023}} He was selected to play in the [[2022 McDonald's All-American Boys Game]] at the end of the season but couldn't due to injury.{{cite web|url=https://www.tuscaloosanews.com/story/sports/college/basketball/2022/01/25/two-alabama-basketball-signees-named-mcdonalds-all-americans-brandon-miller-jaden-bradley/9216709002/|title=Two Alabama basketball signees, Jaden Bradley and Brandon Miller, named McDonald's All-Americans|first=Nick|last=Kelly|work=[[The Tuscaloosa News]]|date=January 25, 2022|access-date=January 11, 2023}} ===Recruiting=== Bradley was considered a five-star [[college recruiting|recruit]] by [[ESPN]], and a four-star recruit by [[247Sports]] and [[Rivals.com|Rivals]].{{cite web|url=https://tucson.com/sports/arizonawildcats/basketball/pascoe/five-star-guard-jaden-bradley-to-announce-college-choice-thursday-afternoon/article_e34158fc-222f-11ec-821b-8f5e2c7c845c.html|title=Five-star guard Jaden Bradley to announce college choice Thursday afternoon|work=[[Arizona Daily Star]]|date=September 30, 2021|access-date=January 11, 2023}}{{cite web|url=https://www.spokesman.com/stories/2021/aug/26/gonzaga-in-mix-for-2022-five-star-point-guard-jade/|title=Gonzaga in mix for 2022 five-star point guard Jaden Bradley|work=[[The Spokesman-Review]]|date=August 26, 2021|access-date=January 11, 2023}} On September 30, 2021, he committed to playing college basketball for [[Alabama Crimson Tide men's basketball|Alabama]] after considering an offer from [[Arizona Wildcats men's basketball|Arizona]] while listing [[Gonzaga Bulldogs men's basketball|Gonzaga]], [[Kentucky Wildcats men's basketball|Kentucky]], and [[Florida State Seminoles men's basketball|Florida State]] as finalists.{{cite web|url=https://www.al.com/alabamabasketball/2021/09/five-star-guard-jaden-bradley-commits-to-alabama.html|title=Five-star guard
